content:
The **age of the universe** is currently estimated to be about **13.8 billion years**. This estimate is based on a variety of observations, including measurements of the **cosmic microwave background radiation** and the **expansion rate of the universe** (the Hubble constant). 

**Source:**  
- NASA (https://map.gsfc.nasa.gov/universe/uni_age.html)
- Planck Collaboration results (2018)

If you would like more detail or the latest updates (including the ongoing Hubble tension debate), feel free to ask!
